purpose: Map K_A(B) against separation for the A-B pair between P-0022 (r 2) and P-0023 (r 9). Separation 4.0, horizontal, at rest, T = 2.5 (before the likely contact). Tracker data for my own free-coupling fits on pre-contact windows. Tests whether the constant-K bands from P-0021 (about 7.75 near r 7 to 3.8) and P-0023 (about 6.2 near r 6.5 to 9) are one curve.
